solution: Touchless AI face recognition terminals with visible-light and infrared cameras. Biometric interlocking airlocks that prevent opening cleanroom doors simultaneously. Comprehensive audit logs recording every access event with non-editable timestamps.
keyFeatures: Contactless face recognition operates through safety goggles and surgical masks
Two-door interlocking airlock controller integration (cleanroom positive pressure maintenance)

Multi-shift rotational roster tracking for 24/7 formulation and API operations
